[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Maximal square** [LC 221 · Maximal Square](https://leetcode.com/problems/maximal-square/){difficulty="Medium"}

A square of side $k$ with bottom-right corner $(r, c)$ leaves three squares of side $k - 1$: delete the last row, the last column, or both. So the side is one more than the shortest of those three neighbours, and only when $(r, c)$ itself is a one. Up and left cover the two edges. The diagonal covers the interior. Drop the diagonal and `[["0","1"],["1","1"]]` reports area $4$.

[Solved in full in @sec-gd-p5-square.]{.card-link}

:::
